_about: What Skillshelf leaves off the site, and why (November 22, 2026). The build skips these. Repos: every listing from that repository. Ids: single listings. Keep: the one listing that stands for a whole pack, with the name and line it shows.

repos.anthropics/skills: Claude already has Anthropic's own skills: they are built into the Claude apps and Claude uses them by itself when a request needs them.
repos.anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins: Anthropic's own plugins are already in Claude's plugin directory.
repos.openai/skills: Written for Codex, OpenAI's coding agent. Many only connect to services Claude connects to directly (Figma, Notion, Linear, Sentry).
repos.NVIDIA/skills: Lab and drug-discovery workflows for NVIDIA's science models: too specialised for this store.

ids.mcp-everything: A test server for people building MCP clients, not for daily use.

ids.mcp-filesystem: Claude Code and the Claude desktop app already work with your files.
